author: Zacks Equity Research
title: Company News For Aug 28, 2018 - August

organizations.name: shares of advanced micro devices inc.

text: Netflix Inc.’s ( NFLX - Free Report ) shares were up 1.6% following news that it was developing a system that would enable the company to avoid paying commissions to Apple Inc. ( AAPL - Free Report ) on app-related transactions Shares of Advanced Micro Devices Inc. ( AMD - Free Report ) surged 5.3% after the company unveiled an innovative Radeon server card for data-center virtualization American Woodmark Corp.’s ( AMWD - Free Report ) shares soared 5.5% after reporting fiscal first quarter 2019 earnings per share of $2.04, beating the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $1.96 Shares of Tesla Inc. ( TSLA - Free Report ) fell 1.1% after its CEO Elon Musk stated that the company would remain public in contradiction to an earlier statement that Tesla was to go private
